faqs.a:
All improvements required by this article shall be completed prior to the issuance
               of a certificate of occupancy for the building which would be served or affected by
               such improvements. Any existing access points that will not be used shall be removed,
               and sidewalk, curbing and other adjacent improvements shall be constructed in the
               place of the access points.
(Code 1981, § 30-151; Ord. No. 1544, § 2, 3-19-1979)
